قُلۡ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡفَلَقِ
Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
Say, ‘I seek the protection of the Lord of the daybreak
Say, O Messenger: “I seek refuge in the Lord of the morning and I seek His protection.”
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ
مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
From the evil of that which He created
from the evil of what He has created
“From the evils of the harms of all creation.”
مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
And from the evil of darkness when it settles
and from the evil of the dark night when it falls
“And I seek refuge in Allah from the evils that appear in the night, i.e. harmful creatures and bandits.”
وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِي ٱلۡعُقَدِ
And from the evil of the blowers in knots
and from the evil of the witches, who blow on knots
“And I seek His refuge from the evils of the sorceresses who blow onto knots.”
وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ
وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
And from the evil of an envier when he envies
and from the evil of the envious one when he envies.’
“And I seek His refuge from the evil of the jealous one when he acts out his jealousy.”
وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
